note: args = [.base file text, op, op args]; expected = the new file text. ops: toggle [group, label], reset [group or null], add [group, label, filter], remove [group, label], preset [name], save-preset [name], save-default [], clear-default [], default [] (no change when the base has no saved default). The state of a switch is read from the top-level filters: one filter of a group as an item of the top-level and list, or an or item that holds only filters of one group. Everything else in the file keeps its text, comments and quotes.

cases.name: turn one switch on: its filter goes to the end of the top-level and list, comments and quotes stay
args:
# Tasks board
filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("Tasks") # only task notes
    - 'priority != "low"'
views:
  - type: table
    name: All
    filters:
      and:
        - status == "todo"
filterSwitches:
  groups:
    - name: Status
      switches:
        - label: Todo
          filter: status == "todo"
        - label: Doing
          filter: status == "doing"
        - label: Done
          filter: status == "done"
cases.expected:
# Tasks board
filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("Tasks") # only task notes
    - 'priority != "low"'
    - status == "todo"
views:
  - type: table
    name: All
    filters:
      and:
        - status == "todo"
filterSwitches:
  groups:
    - name: Status
      switches:
        - label: Todo
          filter: status == "todo"
        - label: Doing
          filter: status == "doing"
        - label: Done
          filter: status == "done"
